title: Building a $1B Company | Ep.13
text:
Building a $1B Company | Ep.13

I'm building a product for online fitness coaches and I have 3 days to finish its methodology before the month ends.
What I learned this week: a bad product ruins your reputation, and a product so good that people recommend it means you never have to advertise again.

Here are the lessons from this week:
A good product compounds. People buy it, recommend it to a friend, and you can charge more for it.
Before I charge anyone, I'm giving it to 5 or 10 coaches for free and improving it until it's good enough to charge for.
My views dropped and I don't know why yet. I'll look into it once the methodology is done.
